summary: Full Stack developer building the software that connects people to the physical world. Currently developing a Kotlin Multiplatform C2 app at Algolight, operating drones and ground robots from a single Android/Linux client for the IDF Robotics and Automation Division, now serving 100+ operators in the field. I own the operator-facing platform end to end: live operations views, real-time video and telemetry, control pipelines, and deployment and monitoring in live field operations. Previously Lead Frontend Developer at IDF Robotics and Automation, leading frontend development of a vehicle remote control system deployed across 100+ remote vehicles.

work.description:
Developing a Kotlin Multiplatform Command and Control (C2) application for operating and supervising heterogeneous robotic units — drones and ground robots — from a single Android/Linux client, serving the IDF’s Robotics and Automation Division, now serving 100+ operators in the field.

- Owning the operator-facing product end to end: building a unit-agnostic architecture where live video (GStreamer/RTSP), MAVLink telemetry, recording, and control are shared pipelines across all unit types.
- Designing and building the real-time operations view operators actually work with — live video, telemetry, and control in one client — now serving 100+ operators in the field.
- Taking end-to-end technical responsibility from design to production release, including deployment and monitoring in live field operations.
- Leading system design and strategic planning for multi-faceted defense projects, working directly with defense industry stakeholders to deliver field-ready solutions.
work.title: Software Developer

Leading the design and development of frontend architecture and backend features for full-stack applications in the field of autonomous robotics and drones.
